vendor_and_service: Public cloud provider (SYS-07 landing zone: GDSR, analytics, backup vault, pilot-light DR)
tier_rationale: Hosts GDSR (SOC 2 scope), the backup vault, and DR for WMS and CAP/EDMS; supports High BIA processes through recovery
assurance_required: Annual review of the provider SOC 2 Type 2 from its compliance portal
subservice_organizations: None relevant to the services used
exceptions_noted: None relevant to the services used
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer controls under the shared responsibility model: identity, network rules, keys, logging, backups (P04). Mapped to AC-2, SC-7, SC-12, AU-2, CP-9. Company gaps: cloud virtual machines not scanned (POAM-015); GDSR logs not in the SIEM (POAM-005)
availability_vs_bia: Region-level availability commitments per service; company keeps backups in a second region; single region for GDSR accepted (R-027)
follow_up: Carve-out subservice organization in the GDSR system description; list the complementary subservice organization controls the company relies on

vendor_and_service: Cloud identity provider and privileged access broker (SYS-03)
tier_rationale: Authentication for all workforce and contractor identities; supports every process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus status history review
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures MFA, conditional access, administrator roles, and break-glass accounts. Mapped to IA-2(1), AC-2, AC-6. Company gap: push MFA for administrators, not phishing-resistant (POAM-002)
availability_vs_bia: 99.99% monthly uptime commitment; no RTO stated; identity outage is R-032 (break-glass accounts)
incident_notification_terms: Security incident notice per the terms of service
follow_up: Test break-glass accounts quarterly; FIDO2 for administrators by 2027-01-31

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SIEM and EDR operator for SYS-08)
tier_rationale: Privileged EDR agents on all endpoints and servers; security logs that can contain SRI fragments; detection for every process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) plus bridge letter; annual service review with detection tests
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 3 of 40 samples; 1 analyst access removal late. Management response: added staffing
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must keep the escalation list current, define log sources, approve containment, and review monthly reports. Mapped to IR-4, SI-4, AU-2. Company gaps: log sources incomplete (POAM-005); the CST is not yet on the escalation list for boundary events (R-037)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; the MSSP continuity plan covers its operations center (tested annually per the report)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; security incident affecting company data within 24 hours
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform SOC 2; add the CST to the escalation list; quarterly escalation tests (R-037). The MSSP has no access to Level 3 or Level 4

vendor_and_service: Work management system vendor (SYS-01 application; remote support by VPN)
tier_rationale: Network access through the vendor VPN; supports BP-02 clearance and tagging (RTO 4 h) and BP-03
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 if available, otherwise an independent security assessment plus the security addendum, annually
report_type_and_period: No SOC 2 report; vendor completed the company questionnaire 2026-08
cuecs_and_company_mapping: The application runs on company servers, so most controls are the company's. Vendor-relevant controls: named support accounts, MFA, session approval and recording (POAM-003); patch support for the clearance module on Windows Server 2012 R2 until the 2027 upgrade (POAM-017)
availability_vs_bia: Vendor support response 4 hours for severity 1; recovery is the company's (POAM-010)
incident_notification_terms: Support contract silent on security incident notice
follow_up: Security addendum at the 2027 renewal (named accounts, MFA, 72-hour incident notice); independent assessment or SOC 2 by 2027-12-31; interconnection terms (POAM-006)
reviewer_and_date: IT Security Manager and Director of Work Management, 2026-09-11

vendor_and_service: ERP and HR/payroll SaaS with applicant tracking (SYS-05)
tier_rationale: Personal information of about 850 employees and applicants; supply chain records for safety-related parts; supports BP-13 (RTO 12 h) and BP-15
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 25 vendor changes deployed without documented approval; remediated
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages roles, segregation of duties, user reviews, and integration credentials. Mapped to AC-2, AC-5, AC-6. Company gaps: access reviews annual, transfers keep roles (POAM-001); AI ranking feature enabled by vendor default (P10 AI-004)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h: meets BP-13 (RTO 12 h, RPO 4 h) and BP-15 (RTO 72 h)
incident_notification_terms: Contract requires breach notice with no stated time; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) requires 10 days
follow_up: Amend the contract to a 10-day (or shorter) breach notice (G-081, due 2027-03-31); confirm the AI ranking feature can be disabled per tenant (P10)

tier_rationale: Supports BP-08 ERO callout (RTO 1 h, MTD 1 h); emergency plan staffing depends on it
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security and Availability) plus a failover test report
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer maintains the roster, tests callouts, and controls administrator accounts. Mapped to CP-8, AC-2. Company gaps: the service was never evaluated by the CST (POAM-019); administrators not in the 73.56 program (POAM-014)
availability_vs_bia: 99.9% availability commitment; no RTO stated; does not show it can meet a 1-hour MTD without the printed call tree (P01 R-007)
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 72 hours of a confirmed security incident
follow_up: Obtain the current report by 2026-11-30; second callout path by 2026-12-31 (POAM-019); CST evaluation result to decide whether the service is in CSP scope
reviewer_and_date: Emergency Preparedness Manager and Compliance and GRC Lead, 2026-09-14

vendor_and_service: Predictive maintenance vendor (AI-001; sensor gateway and SaaS)
tier_rationale: Gateway on balance-of-plant equipment with its own cellular link; vendor VPN support account; plant equipment data
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 or independent assessment plus the security addendum and AI terms (P10)
report_type_and_period: No SOC 2 report; vendor offered a penetration test summary of its SaaS
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must control what data leaves (vibration and temperature only), the gateway placement, and vendor accounts. Mapped to CA-3, SA-9, AC-17. Company gaps: CST evaluation of the gateway (POAM-019); interconnection terms (POAM-006); shared vendor VPN account (POAM-003)
availability_vs_bia: Not critical to the BIA (time-based maintenance continues)
incident_notification_terms: Pilot agreement has no incident notice term
follow_up: No expansion of the pilot until the P10 conditions are met; security addendum with 72-hour incident notice and data-use terms by 2026-11-30
reviewer_and_date: Maintenance Manager and IT Security Manager, 2026-09-14

vendor_and_service: Background screening vendor (access authorization support; SYS-11 interface)
tier_rationale: Restricted personal information for access authorization (criminal history results, employment history) for about 2,000 people a year including outage contractors
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus bridge letter
report_type_and_period: Type 1 as of 2026-01-31 only (Type 2 in progress)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer controls: named users, MFA, secure transfer to the enclave, retention. Mapped to AC-2, SC-8, SI-12. Company gap: enclave reachable by domain administrators (G-065)
availability_vs_bia: Supports BP-07 (RTO 12 h): stated RTO 24 h; before an outage the company pre-processes contractors 30 days ahead, so the gap is tolerable
incident_notification_terms: Contract says 30 days; Fla. Stat. 501.171(6) requires 10 days (G-081)
follow_up: Obtain the Type 2 report when issued (vendor target 2027-01-31); amend breach notice to 10 days or shorter by 2027-03-31
reviewer_and_date: Director of Security and Compliance and GRC Lead, 2026-09-15

tier_rationale: All business communications; SRI risk if misfiled; supports BP-16 (RTO 8 h)
assurance_required: Annual review of the vendor SOC 2 Type 2 from its portal

exceptions_noted: None relevant to the services used
